turns.input: Without using any tools: explain in two sentences how plan-and-execute agents differ from ReAct loops.
turns.answer: Plan-and-execute agents create a plan, execute it, and then evaluate the result to formulate the next plan, iterating until a goal is reached, whereas ReAct loops continuously observe the environment, take actions, and adjust their strategies based on feedback without a predefined initial plan.
